title: For each instance display name, show the variance of instance memory (in MB
question: For each instance display name, show the variance of instance memory (in MB) across its system metadata entries, along with the overall memory range (max minus min) and overall memory variance (in MB), considering only instances that are not deleted. Do not return any rounded answers.

       VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS variance_across_metadata,
       MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range,
       VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS overall_memory_variance
FROM instances AS i
JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid
WHERE i.deleted = 0
